Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Young Professional-I (YP-I) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Young Professional-I posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I posts at ICAR CRRI is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Young Professional-I position is a B.Sc. degree in Agriculture, Botany, Zoology, Environmental Science, or Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I role?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-I position is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-I post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-I post at ICAR Central Rice Research Institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional-I position will involve a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the ICAR CRRI Young Professional-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR Central Rice Research Institute located?
faq.answer: ICAR Central Rice Research Institute is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
